# Apify Email Signature Generator

The Apify actor [`apify/email-signature-generator`](https://apify.com/apify/email-signature-generator) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.6**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Generates a standardized email signature for Apify team members, using provided details.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/email-signature-generator) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-email-signature-generator@0.0.6#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      fullName: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fullName` | string | yes |  | Full Name — The full name displayed in the signature. |
| `position` | string | yes |  | Position — Your position in Apify. |
| `phoneNumber` | string |  |  | Phone Number — Your phone number. |
| `twitterUrl` | string |  |  | Twitter URL — The URL of your Twitter. |
| `linkedInUrl` | string |  |  | LinkedIn URL — The URL of your LinkedIn. |
| `githubUrl` | string |  |  | GitHub URL — The URL of your GitHub. |
| `hubspotUrl` | string |  |  | Hubspot URL — The URL for Hubspot meetings. |
| `otherUrls` | array |  |  | Other URLs — Other URLs. The first value is the label (e.g. "Facebook"), the second one is the URL (e.g. "https://facebook.com") |
| `apifyUrl` | string |  |  | Apify Profile URL — The URL of your Apify profile. |
| `apifyUrlLabel` | string |  |  | Apify Profile URL Label — Optional label for your Apify profile URL. The default is "Apify Profile" |
| `shouldDisplayHiring` | boolean | yes |  | Should Display Hiring Information — Determines whether the hiring link gets displayed. |
| `shouldDisplayG2` | boolean |  |  | Should Display G2 banner — Determines whether the G2 banner gets displayed. |
| `type` | string | yes | `"Gmail"` | Signature type — The signature type. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
